# Worked math-channel examples for the user handbook (issue 7.5).
#
# Format, one example per line:   <expr> || <bindings> || <expected>
#   - <expr>     a math-channel expression, evaluated through the *real*
#                racestudio-analysis `expr` engine (parse_str + eval_scalar).
#   - <bindings> comma-separated `name=value` channel bindings (empty for a
#                constant expression).
#   - <expected> the scalar value the engine must produce (compared within 1e-9).
#
# Every expression below is ALSO shown verbatim in
# docs/handbook/03-math-channels.md; `test_worked_examples_evaluate` evaluates
# each one here AND asserts it appears in that chapter, so a worked example can
# never silently drift from what the engine actually computes.
#
# Blank lines and `#` comment lines are ignored.

# Precedence & grouping
2 + 3 * 4 || || 14
(2 + 3) * 4 || || 20
100 / 5 / 2 || || 10

# Built-in functions
abs(-9.81) || || 9.81
sqrt(pow(3, 2) + pow(4, 2)) || || 5
min(2, 5) || || 2
max(2, 5) || || 5
pow(2, 10) || || 1024
clamp(120, 0, 100) || || 100

# Channel references (bindings resolve the referenced channels)
sqrt(Ax*Ax + Ay*Ay) || Ax=3, Ay=4 || 5
2 * v + 1 || v=10 || 21
GPS_Speed / 3.6 || GPS_Speed=90 || 25
